exercises.q: Tom covered himself with a blanket.
exercises.why: **укрылся** — укры́ться (perfective): to cover/wrap oneself; to seek shelter, to find/take shelter/cover, to take cover; to escape. Wiktionary: укры́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **покрылся** — покры́ться (perfective): to cover oneself, to get covered; to be covered (with). Wiktionary: покры́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **покрылась** — покры́ться (perfective): to cover oneself, to get covered; to be covered (with). Wiktionary: покры́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: roofing, roof covering, rooftop (the outer surface of a roof)
to cover oneself, to get covered
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: покрови́тельство — patronage, protection; кро́вля — roofing, roof covering, rooftop (the outer surface of a roof); укры́ться — to cover/wrap oneself; покры́ться — to cover oneself, to get covered.
